description: Choose a discovery mode, optionally narrow the search with filters, and pick which repository details to enrich.

contributorsLimit.description: How many contributors to keep when 'Include contributors' is on.
contributorsLimit.title: Contributors per repository

createdAfter.description: Only repositories created on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
createdAfter.title: Created after

githubToken.description: Optional personal access token. It only raises the request limit from 60 to 5,000 requests per hour and is never required. A classic token with no scopes is enough for public data.
githubToken.sectionDescription: Optional settings for higher limits and private repositories.
githubToken.title: GitHub personal access token (optional)

includeActivity.description: Fetch 52 weeks of commit activity and the latest commit (up to two requests per repository; GitHub may need a moment to compute the statistics).
includeActivity.title: Include commit activity

includeArchived.description: Keep archived repositories in the results. Turn this off to find actively maintained projects only.
includeArchived.title: Include archived repositories

includeContributors.description: Fetch the ranked contributor list with contribution counts (one request per repository; GitHub caps this endpoint at 500 contributors).
includeContributors.title: Include contributors

includeForks.description: Include fork repositories in search, owner, and topic results. Direct mode always returns the repositories you list.
includeForks.title: Include forks

includeLanguages.description: Include the byte count per programming language (one API request per repository).
includeLanguages.title: Include language breakdown

includeReadme.description: Fetch and include the decoded README text (capped at 500 KB).
includeReadme.title: Include README

includeReleases.description: Fetch the newest releases, including tag, dates, prerelease flag, and asset count (one request per repository).
includeReleases.title: Include releases

includeRepoDetails.description: Fetch the repository detail endpoint in search, owner, and topic modes to add the real watcher count, network count, and organisation/parent fields (one extra API request per repository). Direct mode always fetches these.
includeRepoDetails.title: Include full repository details

language.description: Only repositories whose primary language matches. Pick a common language here, or type any other language in 'Custom language'.
language.title: Language

languageCustom.description: Any GitHub language name not listed above (e.g. 'Hare', 'Gleam'). Overrides the Language dropdown when non-empty.
languageCustom.title: Custom language

license.description: Only repositories released under this license.
license.title: License

maxResults.description: Hard cap on repositories returned. GitHub's search API itself is capped at 1,000 results.
maxResults.sectionDescription: Choose how much data to enrich and how many repositories to return.
maxResults.title: Maximum repositories

minForks.description: Only repositories with at least this many forks. 0 means no fork filter.
minForks.title: Minimum forks

minStars.description: Only repositories with at least this many stars. 0 means no star filter.
minStars.title: Minimum stars

mode.description: How to find repositories. 'search' runs a GitHub search query, 'direct' fetches an explicit list, 'owner' lists a user or organisation's repositories, and 'topic' lists repositories tagged with a topic.
mode.sectionDescription: Pick a discovery path and the repositories it should cover.
mode.title: Mode

owner.description: GitHub user or organisation whose repositories should be listed (mode=owner). Accepts 'apify' or 'https://github.com/apify'.
owner.title: Owner

pushedAfter.description: Only repositories with a push on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Useful for finding maintained projects.
pushedAfter.title: Pushed after

releasesLimit.description: How many releases to keep when 'Include releases' is on.
releasesLimit.title: Releases per repository

repositoryUrls.description: Repositories to fetch (mode=direct). Accepts https://github.com/owner/repo, a trailing slash, .git, the git@github.com:owner/repo.git SSH form, or a plain owner/repo slug. Duplicates are removed.
repositoryUrls.title: Repository URLs or slugs

searchIn.description: Where the free-text part of searchQuery must match (mode=search). Applies only when searchQuery contains free text.
searchIn.title: Search text in

searchQuery.description: GitHub search expression (mode=search). Supports qualifiers such as 'stars:>10000', 'language:python', 'topic:llm', 'user:apify', 'pushed:>2025-01-01', and 'in:name,description'. In owner/topic mode it is an optional keyword filter added to the owner or topic.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Sort key for search, owner, and topic results.
sortBy.sectionDescription: Optional narrowing applied to search, owner, and topic modes.
sortBy.title: Sort by

sortOrder.description: Ascending or descending order for the selected sort key.
sortOrder.title: Sort direction

topic.description: Topic tag to browse (mode=topic), e.g. 'llm', 'machine-learning', or 'web-scraping'. A leading 'topic:' is accepted and stripped.
topic.title: Topic

title: GitHub Repository Metadata & README Extractor input
